## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, images, or examples about the feature request here.

## Priority
- [ ] Critical - Blocks major functionality
- [ ] High - Important feature
- [ ] Medium - Normal priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have

## Complexity
- [ ] Simple - Can be done in a few hours
- [ ] Medium - Requires some development effort
- [ ] Complex - Major feature requiring significant work
